faq_heading: Scottsdale condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Scottsdale. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Scottsdale, North Delta: 24 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 4 North Delta communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Scottsdale fell from 30 in June to 24 in September, and 9 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 33.8% of North Delta’s 71 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Scottsdale?
Scottsdale also had 53 houses listed and 10 sold in September, against 24 condos and townhomes listed. The Scottsdale houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Scottsdale?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 24 condos and townhomes listed in Scottsdale. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Scottsdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Scottsdale had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Scottsdale from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 condos and townhomes sold in Scottsdale over those 4 months, out of 35 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
